Fine-tune MobileNetV2 on malaria cell images and export to ONNX.

Nettoyage des données UAT locales RuggyLab OS.
Instance de TEST du flux SORTANT RuggyLab -> CSA (I2).

Smoke test bout-en-bout d'une instance RuggyLab OS déjà démarrée.

compose.role: Stack de production — mode nominal supporté

command:
while true; do
  ts=$$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
  f=/backups/ruggylab_pg-$$ts.dump
  if pg_dump -Fc -f "$$f"; then
    sha256sum "$$f" > "$$f.sha256"
    date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > /backups/last_success.txt
    echo "backup OK: $$f"
    find /backups -name 'ruggylab_pg-*' -mtime +"$$BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS" -delete
  else
    echo "backup FAILED at $$ts" >&2
  fi
  sleep "$$BACKUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS"
done
